verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser has a dedicated startups and entrepreneurs practice page and says its attorneys wrote the book 'Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders'. Its openly accessible practice pages give some explainer framing, such as founders adapting visas meant for other purposes and O-3 dependent eligibility on the O-1 page. However, nothing shows the book is free or ungated, and the free content shown is thin practice-page copy rather than substantial guides. Missing for 10: evidence of free, ungated, in-depth startup visa guides; detailed criteria breakdowns; step-by-step process explainers; real founder case examples; independent corroboration.
